svg.desc: Graphs of horizontal branch separation against height before, at, and after a cubic contact. The axis meeting persists; two extra nearby crossings appear afterwards. Both branches keep moving. The axes have separate labeled scales.
svg.title: The branches trade places at a cubic contact

cc:Work.dc:title: The branches trade places at a cubic contact
cc:Work.dc:description: Before, at, and after the first central-axis contact of the 2/3 to 4/7 arm detour. Graphs show horizontal separation against height, with separate labeled axis scales. The axis meeting persists; two extra nearby crossings appear after contact. Both branches have nonzero velocities throughout.

g.text: First detour, middle leg. Plot the horizontal separation between the two selected end branches.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c7c7d4

g.text: Each meeting is a zero of this separation: an intersection with the vertical line.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #c7c7d4

font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c7c7d4

g.text: At contact both branches still move at about 292.46 drawing units per radian. Their separation first differs cubically.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c7c7d4

g.text: The axes have separate labeled scales. These are graphs of separation against height. Exact event isolation is a separate calculation.
